description: The classic snake game on a 20×20 canvas — keyboard and touch controls, speeding up as you eat.

faqs.a: Yes — use the arrow keys or WASD. On mobile, tap the on-screen direction pad.
faqs.q: Can I play on my phone?

faqs.a: It starts at a relaxed pace and gets 4ms faster per food, down to a minimum step time — so it keeps getting harder.
Yes, in your browser's local storage. Nothing is sent anywhere.

howto: Steer with arrow keys / WASD or the on-screen pad.
Eat the red food to grow and score 10 points.
Avoid walls and your own tail — then beat your best.
title: Snake Game
